text: Table 4 reports precision, recall and F1 for LM vs LM with ChatGPT as both examiner and examinee, compared to baselines. The LM vs LM row gives P/R/F1 triples of 85.1/70.7/76.7, 82.8/71.6/76.8, 74.5/74.9/77.7 and 83.6/77.1/80.2, and the LM vs LM (Majority) row gives 86.6/75.8/80.8, 84.5/80.8/82.6, 82.3/76.1/79.1 and 87.0/84.0/85.4. An ablation without the follow-up questions stage gives 83.8/68.1/75.1, 82.3/69.7/75.5, 74.8/72.1/73.4 and 82.0/73.3/77.4.
title: ChatGPT examining ChatGPT: LM vs LM F1 76.7-80.2, Majority 79.1-85.4 (Table 4)
